local function v_u_132(p113) -- name: getHiddenPosition
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16
	local v114 = p113.Object
	local v115 = v114.Parent
	local v116 = v114:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
	if not (v115 and (v115:IsA("GuiBase2d") and v116)) then
		return p113.VisiblePosition
	end
	local v117 = v114.Position
	local v118 = p113.VisiblePosition
	local v119 = v115.AbsoluteSize
	local v120 = Vector2.new((v117.X.Scale - v118.X.Scale) * v119.X + v117.X.Offset - v118.X.Offset, (v117.Y.Scale - v118.Y.Scale) * v119.Y + v117.Y.Offset - v118.Y.Offset)
	local v_u_121 = v114.AbsolutePosition
	local v_u_122 = v114.AbsolutePosition + v114.AbsoluteSize
	local function v_u_125(p123) -- name: include
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_121, (ref) v_u_122, (copy) v_u_125
		for _, v124 in ipairs(p123:GetChildren()) do
			if not (v124:IsA("GuiObject") and v124.Visible) then
				continue
			end
			v_u_121 = v_u_121:Min(v124.AbsolutePosition)
			v_u_122 = v_u_122:Max(v124.AbsolutePosition + v124.AbsoluteSize)
			v_u_125(v124)
		end
	end
	v_u_125(v114)
	v_u_121 = v_u_121 - v120
	v_u_122 = v_u_122 - v120
	local v126 = v116.AbsolutePosition
	local v127 = v116.AbsolutePosition + v116.AbsoluteSize
	local v128 = v_u_16.BattleHideMargin
	local v129 = p113.Direction
	local v130
	if v129.X < 0 then
		v130 = v126.X - v_u_122.X - v128
	else
		v130 = v129.X <= 0 and 0 or v127.X - v_u_121.X + v128
	end
	local v131
	if v129.Y < 0 then
		v131 = v126.Y - v_u_122.Y - v128
	else
		v131 = v129.Y <= 0 and 0 or v127.Y - v_u_121.Y + v128
	end
	return v118 + UDim2.fromOffset(v130, v131)
end
local function v_u_146(p133, p134, p135) -- name: moveTargets
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_132, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_16
	local v136 = v_u_25
	local v137 = v_u_26
	local v138
	if v136 and v137 then
		local v139 = v136.AbsolutePosition.Y + v136.AbsoluteSize.Y - v137.AbsolutePosition.Y - v137.AbsoluteSize.Y
		v138 = math.max(0, v139)
	else
		v138 = 0
	end
	for _, v_u_140 in ipairs(v_u_24) do
		if v_u_140.Bottom ~= p133 then
			continue
		end
		if v_u_140.Tween then
			v_u_140.Tween:Cancel()
			v_u_140.Tween = nil
		end
		local v141
		if p134 then
			if v_u_140.Drop then
				v141 = v_u_140.VisiblePosition + UDim2.fromOffset(0, v138)
			else
				v141 = v_u_132(v_u_140)
			end
		else
			v141 = v_u_140.VisiblePosition
		end
		if p135 then
			v_u_140.Object.Position = v141
		else
			local v142 = v_u_4
			local v143 = v_u_140.Object
			local v144
			if p134 then
				v144 = v_u_16.BattleHideTweenInfo
			else
				v144 = v_u_16.BattleShowTweenInfo
			end
			local v_u_145 = v142:Create(v143, v144, {
				["Position"] = v141
			})
			v_u_140.Tween = v_u_145
			v_u_145.Completed:Once(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_140, (copy) v_u_145
				if v_u_140.Tween == v_u_145 then
					v_u_140.Tween = nil
				end
			end)
			v_u_145:Play()
		end
	end
end

end

function v_u_21.RequestPrice(p_u_48) -- name: RequestPrice
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_46, (ref) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_22
	local v49
	if type(p_u_48) == "number" and p_u_48 == p_u_48 then
		v49 = math.abs(p_u_48) < (1 / 0)
	else
		v49 = false
	end
	if v49 and (p_u_48 > 0 and not (v_u_26[p_u_48] or v_u_27[p_u_48])) then
		v_u_27[p_u_48] = true
		local v_u_50 = v_u_17.GetPurchaseInfoType(p_u_48)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_48, (copy) v_u_50, (ref) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_46, (ref) v_u_36, (ref) v_u_22
			for v51 = 1, v_u_19.PriceAttempts do

				local v53 = v_u_1
				local v54 = p_u_48
				local v55 = v_u_50
				local v56, v57 = pcall(v52, v53, v54, v55)
				local v58
				if v56 and type(v57) == "table" then
					local v59 = v57.PriceInRobux
					v58 = tonumber(v59) or nil
				else
					v58 = nil
				end
				if v58 then
					local v60
					if type(v58) == "number" and v58 == v58 then
						v60 = math.abs(v58) < (1 / 0)

					end

						local v61 = v_u_26
						local v62 = p_u_48
						local v63 = v58 + 0.5
						v61[v62] = math.floor(v63)
						v_u_27[p_u_48] = nil

		end)

end

	local v89 = v_u_20

				else

				end

				v231.Position = UDim2.new(v238, v232.Position.Y)
				v231.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

			end
		end
		if p225.Title then

			else

					v228 = v239[#v239 - 1].Multiplier
				else
					v228 = 1
				end
			end

local function v_u_278() -- name: refreshCards
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_39, (copy) v_u_246, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_257, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_169, (copy) v_u_196, (copy) v_u_204
	local v265 = v_u_8.Replicas.ProfileStore
	if v265 then
		v265 = v265.Data
	end
	if type(v265) ~= "table" then
		v265 = nil
	end
	if v265 then
		for _, v266 in ipairs(v_u_39) do
			v_u_246(v266, v265)
		end
		for _, v267 in ipairs(v_u_40) do
			v_u_257(v267, v265)
		end
		local v268 = {}
		for _, v269 in ipairs(v_u_38) do
			local v270 = v269.Key
			local v271 = v_u_11.Products[v270]
			if type(v271) ~= "table" then
				v271 = nil
			end
			if not (v271 and v269.Card.Parent) then
				continue
			end
			if v269.Kind == "Pack" then
				v_u_169(v269.Card, v271, v265)
			else
				if v269.Kind ~= "Cash" and v269.Kind ~= "Power" then
					continue
				end
				local v272 = v_u_196(v269.Card, v271, v265)
				local v273 = v268[v269.Kind]
				if not v272 or v273 and v273.Value >= v272 then
					continue
				end
				v268[v269.Kind] = {
					["Card"] = v269.Card,
					["Value"] = v272
				}
			end
		end
		for _, v274 in ipairs({ "Cash", "Power" }) do
			local v275 = v268[v274]
			local v276 = v_u_204
			local v277
			if v275 then
				v277 = v275.Card
			else
				v277 = nil
			end
			v276(v274, v277)
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_336() -- name: stepEffects
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_45, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_10
	local v306 = os.clock()
	local v307 = v_u_6.ReducedMotionEnabled
	for _, v308 in ipairs(v_u_45.Shines) do
		local v309 = (v306 + v308.Phase) % v_u_19.ShinePeriod / v_u_19.ShineSweep
		v308.Gradient.Offset = Vector2.new((v309 >= 1 or v307) and -1 or -1 + v309 * 2, 0)
	end
	for _, v310 in ipairs(v_u_45.Pulses) do
		local v311 = v310.Scale
		local v312
		if v307 then
			v312 = 1
		else
			local v313 = v306 * v_u_19.PulseSpeed + v310.Phase
			v312 = 1 + (math.sin(v313) * 0.5 + 0.5) * v_u_19.PulseAmount
		end
		v311.Scale = v312
	end
	for _, v314 in ipairs(v_u_45.Bobs) do
		local v315
		if v307 then
			v315 = 0
		else
			local v316 = v306 * v_u_19.BobSpeed + v314.Phase
			v315 = math.sin(v316)
		end
		local v317 = v314.Position
		v314.Object.Position = UDim2.new(v317.X.Scale, v317.X.Offset, v317.Y.Scale - v315 * v_u_19.BobRise * v314.Object.Size.Y.Scale, v317.Y.Offset)
		v314.Object.Rotation = v314.Rotation + v315 * v_u_19.BobTilt
	end
	for _, v318 in ipairs(v_u_45.Sparkles) do
		local v319 = v306 * v_u_19.SparkleSpeed + v318.Phase
		local v320 = math.sin(v319)
		local v321 = math.max(0, v320)
		local v322 = v318.Size
		v318.Image.Size = UDim2.new(v322.X.Scale * v321, 0, v322.Y.Scale * v321, 0)
		v318.Image.Rotation = v306 * 60 % 360
	end
	for _, v323 in ipairs(v_u_45.Bursts) do
		v323.Rotation = v307 and 0 or v306 * v_u_19.BurstSpeed % 360
	end
	for _, v324 in ipairs(v_u_45.Badges) do
		local v325 = v324.Object
		local v326 = v324.Rotation
		local v327
		if v307 then
			v327 = 0
		else
			local v328 = v306 * v_u_19.BadgeWobbleSpeed + v324.Phase
			v327 = math.sin(v328) * v_u_19.BadgeWobble
		end
		v325.Rotation = v326 + v327
	end
	for _, v329 in ipairs(v_u_45.Flows) do
		v329.Gradient.Color = v_u_10.Colours(v329.Colours, v306 * v_u_19.FlowSpeed)
	end
	for _, v330 in ipairs(v_u_45.Sways) do
		local v331
		if v307 then
			v331 = 0
		else
			local v332 = v306 * v_u_19.SwaySpeed + v330.Phase
			local v333 = math.sin(v332)
			local v334 = v_u_19.SwayAngle
			v331 = v333 * math.rad(v334)
		end
		local v335 = CFrame.new(v330.Focus)
		v330.Camera.CFrame = v335 * CFrame.Angles(0, v331, 0) * v335:Inverse() * v330.Base
	end
end

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_36, (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_278, (ref) v_u_336

							warn("[Shop]: " .. tostring(v344))

				end)
			end

	end
end
local function v_u_347(p346) -- name: isShowing
	while p346 do
		if p346:IsA("GuiObject") and not p346.Visible then
			return false
		end

			return false
		end
		p346 = p346.Parent
	end
	return true
end

local function v_u_29(p13) -- name: getBiome
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_5
	local v14 = v_u_6.DefaultBiome
	local v15 = v_u_6.AreaReach
	local v16 = v_u_5.Get()
	if v16 then
		v16 = v16:FindFirstChild(v_u_6.VisualsFolderName)
	end
	if v16 then
		v16 = v16:FindFirstChild(v_u_6.AmbienceFolderName)
	end
	if not v16 then
		return v14
	end
	for _, v17 in ipairs(v16:GetChildren()) do
		local v18 = v17:GetAttribute(v_u_6.BiomeAttributeName)
		if not v17:IsA("BasePart") or (type(v18) ~= "string" or not v_u_6.Loops[v18]) then
			continue
		end
		local v19 = v17.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p13)
		local v20 = v17.Size * 0.5
		local v21 = v19.X
		local v22 = math.abs(v21) - v20.X
		local v23 = math.max(v22, 0)
		local v24 = v19.Z
		local v25 = math.abs(v24) - v20.Z
		local v26 = math.max(v25, 0)
		local v27 = v23 * v23 + v26 * v26
		local v28 = math.sqrt(v27)
		if v28 > v15 then
			continue
		end
		v14 = v18
		v15 = v28
	end
	return v14
end
local function v_u_38(p30) -- name: play

local function v_u_104(p88, p89, p90) -- name: animateButton
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_27
	if p88 and (p88.Card.Visible and v_u_11.IsShown(p88.Card)) then
		if p88.Burst then
			p88.Burst.Rotation = p90 and 0 or p89 * v_u_16.BurstSpeed % 360
		end
		if p88.Aura then
			p88.Aura.Rotation = p90 and 0 or p89 * v_u_16.AuraSpeed % 360
		end
		for _, v91 in ipairs(p88.Sparkles) do
			local v92
			if p90 then
				v92 = 1
			else
				local v93 = p89 * v_u_16.SparkleSpeed + v91.Phase
				local v94 = math.sin(v93)
				v92 = math.max(0, v94)
			end
			local v95 = v91.Size
			v91.Image.Size = UDim2.new(v95.X.Scale * v92, v95.X.Offset, v95.Y.Scale * v92, v95.Y.Offset)
		end
		if p88.PricePulse then
			local v96 = p88.PricePulse
			local v97
			if p90 then
				v97 = 1
			else
				local v98 = p89 * v_u_16.PulseSpeed
				v97 = 1 + (math.sin(v98) * 0.5 + 0.5) * v_u_16.PulseAmount
			end
			v96.Scale = v97
		end
		if p88.TimerPulse then
			local v99
			if v_u_27 <= v_u_16.UrgentTime then
				v99 = not p90
			else
				v99 = false
			end
			local v100 = p88.TimerPulse
			local v101
			if v99 then
				local v102 = p89 * v_u_16.UrgentPulseSpeed
				local v103 = math.sin(v102)
				v101 = 1 + math.abs(v103) * v_u_16.UrgentPulseAmount
			else
				v101 = 1
			end
			v100.Scale = v101
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_141(p139) -- name: resetButton

		end

	end
	if p139.Burst then
		p139.Burst.Rotation = 0

	if p139.Aura then
		p139.Aura.Rotation = 0
	end

	end
end

local function v_u_124(p81) -- name: updateNPCFacing
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_34
	local v82 = v_u_8.Character

		v96 = 1
	else

		v96 = 1 - math.exp(v97)
	end

			continue
		end

			if not v101 then
				continue
			end

			end

				v_u_3.Play(v_u_6.GreetingSound, v98)

					local v114 = -v92
					v105 = math.clamp(v113, v114, v92)
					local v115 = v108.Y
					local v116 = math.atan2(v115, v110)
					local v117 = -v95
					v106 = math.clamp(v116, v117, v95)
				end
			end
			v99.CurrentYaw = v99.CurrentYaw + (v105 - v99.CurrentYaw) * v96
			v99.CurrentPitch = v99.CurrentPitch + (v106 - v99.CurrentPitch) * v96

			v100.Transform = v100.C0:Inverse() * v101.CFrame:Inverse() * v118 * v100.C1

			end

local function v_u_181(p167, p168, p169) -- name: getGap
	local v170 = p167:PointToObjectSpace(p169)
	local v171 = v170.X
	local v172 = math.abs(v171) - p168.X * 0.5
	local v173 = math.max(v172, 0)
	local v174 = v170.Y
	local v175 = math.abs(v174) - p168.Y * 0.5
	local v176 = math.max(v175, 0)
	local v177 = v170.Z
	local v178 = math.abs(v177) - p168.Z * 0.5
	local v179 = math.max(v178, 0)
	local v180 = v173 * v173 + v176 * v176 + v179 * v179
	return math.sqrt(v180)

local function v_u_366(p290, p291) -- name: stepMerge

local function v_u_547(p507, p508, p509) -- name: stepLeftOver
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_138, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_438, (copy) v_u_90, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_9

local function v_u_382(p372, p373) -- name: stepSpawn

		end

end

function v_u_7.GetFormation(p405) -- name: GetFormation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13
	local v406 = {}
	local v407 = v_u_13[p405]
	if not v407 then
		return v406
	end
	local v408 = v407.Layout
	local v409 = -v408.Size.Y * 0.5
	local v410 = {}
	for v411, v412 in ipairs(v408.Positions) do
		local v413 = v408.GroupIndices[v411]
		local v414 = v410[v413] or {}
		v410[v413] = v414
		local v415 = v408.Entries[v411]
		local v416 = {}
		local v417 = v408.CFrame
		local v418 = v412.X
		local v419 = v412.Z
		v416.Position = v417 * Vector3.new(v418, v409, v419)
		local v420 = v415.Size.X
		local v421 = v415.Size.Z
		v416.Reach = math.max(v420, v421) * 0.5
		table.insert(v414, v416)
	end
	for v422, v423 in pairs(v410) do
		local v424 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		for _, v425 in ipairs(v423) do
			v424 = v424 + v425.Position
		end
		local v426 = v424 / #v423
		local v427 = 0
		for _, v428 in ipairs(v423) do
			local v429 = (v428.Position - v426).Magnitude + v428.Reach
			v427 = math.max(v427, v429)
		end
		v406[v422] = {
			["Centre"] = v426,
			["Radius"] = v427
		}
	end
	return v406
end

function v12.Step(p223, p224) -- name: Step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_182, (copy) v_u_204, (copy) v_u_213, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_109, (copy) v_u_222
	local v225 = os.clock()
	local v226 = v_u_11.Collect
	for v227 = #v_u_15, 1, -1 do
		local v228 = v_u_15[v227]
		v228.Grown = v228.Grown - p223 / v_u_11.RingShrinkTime
		if v228.Grown <= 0 then
			v228.Ring.Part:Destroy()
			table.remove(v_u_15, v227)
		else
			v_u_6.SetSize(v228.Ring, 1 - (1 - v228.Grown) ^ 3)
			v_u_6.Step(v228.Ring, v228.Position, p223)
		end
	end
	for v229 = #v_u_14, 1, -1 do
		local v230 = v_u_14[v229]
		if v230.Model.Parent then
			if v230.State == "Flying" then
				local v231 = v230.Velocity
				local v232 = v_u_11.Gravity * p223
				v230.Velocity = v231 - Vector3.new(0, v232, 0)
				v230.Position = v230.Position + v230.Velocity * p223
				local v233 = v230.Spin.Magnitude
				if v233 > 0 then
					v230.Rotation = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v230.Spin / v233, v233 * p223) * v230.Rotation
				end
				local v234 = v230.Floor + v230.RestHeight
				if v230.Position.Y <= v234 and v230.Velocity.Y < 0 then
					local v235 = v230.Position.X
					local v236 = v230.Position.Z
					v230.Position = Vector3.new(v235, v234, v236)
					local v237 = v230.Velocity
					local v238 = v237.X * v_u_11.Friction
					local v239 = -v237.Y * v_u_11.Bounce
					local v240 = v237.Z * v_u_11.Friction
					v230.Velocity = Vector3.new(v238, v239, v240)
					v230.Spin = v230.Spin * 0.5
					local v241 = v_u_8.Burst
					local v242 = CFrame.new
					local v243 = v230.Position.X
					local v244 = v230.Floor
					local v245 = v230.Position.Z
					v241("Dust", v242((Vector3.new(v243, v244, v245))), {
						["Scale"] = v_u_11.DustScale
					})
					if not v230.Landed then
						v230.Landed = true
						v_u_10.Play("SwordLand", v230.Attachment)
					end
					if not v230.Ring then
						local v246 = v_u_6.Create

local function v_u_119(p108) -- name: sample
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if p108 < v_u_4.JumpTime then
		local v109 = p108 / v_u_4.JumpTime
		local v110 = v_u_4.JumpHeight * 4 * v109 * (1 - v109)
		local v111 = v_u_4.JumpTilt

		return v110, v111 * math.sin(v112), 0
	end
	local v113 = p108 - v_u_4.JumpTime
	if v113 < v_u_4.BounceTime then
		local v114 = v113 / v_u_4.BounceTime
		return v_u_4.BounceHeight * 4 * v114 * (1 - v114), 0, 0
	end
	local v115 = v113 - v_u_4.BounceTime
	if v115 >= v_u_4.ShakeTime then
		return nil, 0, 0
	end
	local v116 = 1 - v115 / v_u_4.ShakeTime
	local v117 = v_u_4.ShakeAngle
	local v118 = v115 * v_u_4.ShakeFrequency * 2 * 3.141592653589793
	return 0, 0, v117 * math.sin(v118) * v116 * v116
end
local function v_u_127(p120, p121, p122, p123) -- name: pose

	end
	if p123 ~= 0 then
		local v126
		if p123 > 0 then
			v126 = v124.Z
		else
			v126 = -v124.Z
		end

	end

end

local function v_u_258(p233, p234, p235) -- name: watchLoop
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_72, (copy) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_43
	local v236 = os.clock()

end

local function v_u_225(p206) -- name: stepEdgeArrow

local function v_u_163(p155, p156) -- name: fight

	}

		table.insert(v286, v287)

local function v_u_382(p372, p373) -- name: stepSpawn
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_356, (copy) v_u_311, (copy) v_u_227, (copy) v_u_250, (copy) v_u_371
	local v374 = p372.SpawnAt

		local v376 = (p373 - v374) / v375.Duration

		if v376 < 0 then

		else

			end

					p372.SpawnAt = nil
					p372.SpawnStarted = true

				end
			else

		end

	end
end

local function v_u_108(p83) -- name: stepSwords
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_45
	v_u_29 = v_u_29 + p83

	if v84 then
		v85 = v84.CFrame.Position
	else
		v85 = nil
	end
	local v86 = v_u_14.Settings.Float
	local v87 = os.clock()
	for _, v88 in pairs(v_u_25) do
		if v85 then
			local v89 = v88.TopCentre
			local v90 = v_u_18.BillboardHeight
			local v91 = (v89 + Vector3.new(0, v90, 0) - v85).Magnitude > v_u_18.HideDistance
			if v88.Gui.Enabled ~= v91 then
				v88.Gui.Enabled = v91
			end
		end

		if not (v92 and v92.Model.Parent) then
			continue
		end
		local v93 = not v85 and (1 / 0) or (v92.Centre - v85).Magnitude
		local v94 = (v_u_18.FadeStart - v93) / (v_u_18.FadeStart - v_u_18.FadeEnd)
		local v95 = math.clamp(v94, 0, 1) * v_u_18.FadeTransparency
		local v96 = v95 - v92.Fade
		if math.abs(v96) > 0.01 then
			v92.Fade = v95
			for _, v97 in ipairs(v92.Parts) do
				v97.LocalTransparencyModifier = v95
			end
		end
		local v98 = v95 < v_u_18.AuraHideFade
		if v92.AuraShown ~= v98 then
			v92.AuraShown = v98
			for _, v99 in ipairs(v92.AuraEffects) do
				v99.Enabled = v98
			end
		end
		if v_u_18.SwordDistance < v93 then
			continue
		end
		v88.Angle = (v88.Angle + v86.SpinSpeed * p83) % 6.283185307179586
		local v100 = 1
		local v101 = v88.PopStartedAt
		if v101 then
			local v102 = (v87 - v101) / v_u_18.PopTime
			if v102 >= 1 then
				v88.PopStartedAt = nil
			else
				local v103 = v_u_18.PopSize - 1
				local v104 = v102 * 3.141592653589793
				v100 = 1 + v103 * math.sin(v104)
			end
		end
		local v105 = v86.Amplitude
		local v106 = v_u_29 * v86.BobSpeed + v88.Phase
		local v107 = v105 * math.sin(v106)
		v_u_45(v92, v92.Centre + Vector3.new(0, v107, 0), v88.Angle, v100)
	end
end

local function v_u_209(p201, p202, p203) -- name: reach
	local v204 = p203:Dot(p201.RightVector)
	local v205 = math.abs(v204) * p202.X * 0.5
	local v206 = p203:Dot(p201.UpVector)
	local v207 = v205 + math.abs(v206) * p202.Y * 0.5
	local v208 = p203:Dot(p201.LookVector)
	return v207 + math.abs(v208) * p202.Z * 0.5
end
local function v_u_246(p210, p211, p212) -- name: makeSpot
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_209, (ref) v_u_25
	local v213 = v_u_2:FindFirstChild("Resources")
	if v213 then
		v213 = v213:FindFirstChild("Interface")
	end
	if v213 then
		v213 = v213:FindFirstChild(v_u_17.SpotTemplateName)
	end
	local v214 = p210:FindFirstChild(v_u_17.HolderName)
	if not (v213 and (v213:IsA("SurfaceGui") and v214)) then
		return nil
	end
	local v215, v216
	if v214:IsA("Model") then
		v215, v216 = v214:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		if not v214:IsA("BasePart") then
			return nil
		end
		v215 = v214.CFrame
		v216 = v214.Size
	end
	local v217 = p211.Position - v215.Position
	local v218 = v217.X
	local v219 = v217.Z
	local v220 = Vector3.new(v218, 0, v219)
	if v220.Magnitude < 0.5 then
		return nil
	end
	local v221 = v220.Unit
	local v222 = (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)):Cross(v221)
	local v223 = v_u_209(v215, v216, v221)
	local v224 = v217:Dot(v221) + v_u_209(p211.CFrame, p211.Size, v221)
	local v225 = v_u_209(p211.CFrame, p211.Size, v222)
	local v226 = v217:Dot(v222)
	local v227 = (v225 - math.abs(v226)) * 2
	local v228 = v224 - v223
	local v229 = math.min(v228, v227) - v_u_17.SpotMargin * 2
	local v230 = v_u_17.SpotMinSize
	local v231 = v_u_17.SpotSize
	local v232 = math.clamp(v229, v230, v231)
	local v233 = v215.Position.Y - v_u_209(v215, v216, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	local v234 = v215.Position.X
	local v235 = v233 + v_u_17.SpotLift - v_u_17.SpotThickness * 0.5
	local v236 = v215.Position.Z
	local v237 = Vector3.new(v234, v235, v236) + v221 * (v223 + v224) * 0.5
	local v238 = Instance.new("Part")
	v238.Name = p210.Name .. "Spot"
	v238.Anchored = true
	v238.CanCollide = false
	v238.CanQuery = false
	v238.CanTouch = false
	v238.CastShadow = false
	v238.Transparency = 1
	local v239 = v_u_17.SpotThickness
	v238.Size = Vector3.new(v232, v239, v232)
	v238.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v237, v237 + v221)
	local v240 = v213:Clone()
	local v241 = p212 or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local v242 = v240:FindFirstChild("Fill")
	if v242 and v242:IsA("GuiObject") then
		v242.BackgroundColor3 = v241
		v242.BackgroundTransparency = v_u_17.SpotFillTransparency
	end
	local v243 = v240:FindFirstChild("Ring")
	if v243 then
		v243 = v243:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
	end
	if v243 then
		local v244 = v_u_17.SpotRingLighten
		v243.Color = v241:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), v244)
	end
	v240.Parent = v238
	local v245 = v_u_25
	if not v245 or v245.Parent ~= workspace then
		v245 = Instance.new("Folder")
		v245.Name = v_u_17.FolderName
		v245.Parent = workspace

	end

end
local function v_u_262(p247, p248, p249) -- name: placeLock
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v250 = p247.Centre
	local v251 = p247.Bob
	local v252 = v250 + Vector3.new(0, v251, 0)
	local v253 = p249 - v252
	local v254 = v253.Magnitude
	if v254 > 0 then
		local v255 = v253 / v254
		local v256 = p247.Radii
		local v257 = v256.X ^ 2 * (v255.X ^ 2 + v255.Z ^ 2) + v256.Y ^ 2 * v255.Y ^ 2
		local v258 = math.sqrt(v257) + v_u_17.LockGap
		local v259 = v254 * 0.5
		local v260 = math.min(v258, v259)
		p248.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = p247.Top.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(v252 + v255 * v260 - p247.Top.Position)
		local v261 = (v254 - v260) / v254
		p248.Size = UDim2.fromScale(p247.LockSize.X.Scale * v261, p247.LockSize.Y.Scale * v261)
	end
end

local function v_u_351(p337) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_262
	v_u_34 = v_u_34 + p337
	local v338 = v_u_11.IsLow()
	local v339 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local v340
	if v339 then
		v340 = v339.CFrame.Position
	else
		v340 = nil
	end
	for _, v341 in pairs(v_u_24) do
		if v340 then
			local v342 = (v341.Board - v340).Magnitude > v_u_17.HideDistance
			if v341.Gui.Enabled ~= v342 then
				v341.Gui.Enabled = v342
			end
		end
		local v343 = v341.Floating
		if v343 and (v340 and (v341.Centre - v340).Magnitude <= v_u_17.FloatDistance) then
			if v338 then
				if not v341.Still then
					v341.Still = true
					v341.Bob = 0
					v343:PivotTo(CFrame.new(v341.Centre) * v341.FloatOffset)
				end
			else
				v341.Still = false
				v341.Angle = (v341.Angle + v_u_17.SpinSpeed * p337) % 6.283185307179586
				local v344 = v_u_17.BobHeight
				local v345 = v_u_34 * v_u_17.BobSpeed + v341.Phase
				v341.Bob = v344 * math.sin(v345)
				local v346 = CFrame.new
				local v347 = v341.Centre
				local v348 = v341.Bob
				v343:PivotTo(v346(v347 + Vector3.new(0, v348, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, v341.Angle, 0) * v341.FloatOffset)
			end
		end
		local v349 = v341.Lock
		if not v349 then
			continue
		end
		local v350 = v341.Locked
		if v350 then
			if v340 == nil then
				v350 = false
			else
				v350 = (v341.Centre - v340).Magnitude > v_u_17.HideDistance
			end
		end
		if v349.Enabled ~= v350 then
			v349.Enabled = v350
		end
		if not (v350 and v340) then
			continue
		end
		v_u_262(v341, v349, v340)
	end
end

local function v_u_193() -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_148, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_18

	for _, v182 in ipairs(v_u_25) do
		if v182.Drawn then
			continue
		end

	end
	local v183 = v_u_4.ReducedMotionEnabled
	for _, v184 in ipairs(v_u_25) do
		local v185 = v184.Camera
		local v186 = v184.Base
		local v187 = v184.Focus
		if not (v185 and (v186 and (v187 and v185.Parent))) then
			continue
		end
		local v188
		if v183 then
			v188 = 0
		else
			local v189 = v181 * v_u_18.SwaySpeed + v184.Phase
			local v190 = math.sin(v189)
			local v191 = v_u_18.SwayAngle
			v188 = v190 * math.rad(v191)
		end

	end
end

local function v_u_514(p502) -- name: onInputChanged
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_421, (ref) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_433, (copy) v_u_444
	local v503 = v_u_40
	if v503 then
		local v504
		if v503.Gamepad then
			v504 = false
		elseif v503.Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			v504 = p502 == v503.Input
		else
			v504 = p502.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		end
		if v504 then
			local v505 = Vector2.new(p502.Position.X, p502.Position.Y)
			local v506 = v505 - v503.Start

			else
				v509 = v_u_26.DragThreshold
			end

				v503.Moved = true
			end
			if not v503.Dragging and v503.Moved then
				if not v503.Held then
					local v510 = v506.Y
					local v511 = math.abs(v510)
					local v512 = v506.X

						return
					end

					if v513 then
						v513.Grid.ScrollingEnabled = false

					end
				end

			end

		end
	end
end

local function v_u_274(p261, p262, p263, p264, p265) -- name: spring
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v266 = (p264 or v_u_12.Frequency) * 3.141592653589793 * 2
	local v267 = p265 or v_u_12.Damping
	local v268 = -v267 * p263
	local v269 = math.exp(v268)
	local v270 = v266 * p263
	local v271 = math.cos(v270)
	local v272 = v266 * p263
	local v273 = math.sin(v272)
	return (p261 * v271 + (p262 + p261 * v267) * (v273 / v266)) * v269, (p262 * v271 - (p262 * v267 + p261 * (v266 * v266 + v267 * v267)) * (v273 / v266)) * v269
end
function v_u_14.Step(p275) -- name: Step
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_52, (copy) v_u_274, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_39
	if v_u_16 and (not v_u_16:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or v_u_16 ~= v_u_11.Get()) then
		v_u_14.Clear()
		return
	elseif p275 > 0 and p275 == p275 then
		for v276, v277 in pairs(v_u_22) do
			v277.Elapsed = v277.Elapsed + p275
			if v277.Elapsed >= v_u_12.RockDuration or not (v276:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and v277.Handle:IsDescendantOf(v276)) then
				v_u_52(v276, v277)
			else
				local v278, v279 = v_u_274(v277.Rotation, v277.AngularVelocity, p275, v_u_12.RockFrequency, v_u_12.RockDamping)
				v277.Rotation = v278
				v277.AngularVelocity = v279
				if v277.Rotation.Magnitude > v_u_12.RockMaximumAngle then
					local v280 = v277.Rotation
					local v281 = v_u_12.RockMaximumAngle
					local v282 = v280.Magnitude
					if v281 < v282 then
						v280 = v280 * (v281 / v282)
					end
					v277.Rotation = v280
					local v283 = v277.AngularVelocity:Dot(v277.Rotation) / v277.Rotation:Dot(v277.Rotation)
					if v283 > 0 then
						v277.AngularVelocity = v277.AngularVelocity - v277.Rotation * v283
					end
				end

local function v_u_64(p13, p14) -- name: fit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v15 = p13.AbsoluteSize
	local v16 = (v15.X <= 0 or v15.Y <= 0) and 1 or v15.X / v15.Y
	local v17 = v_u_5.FieldOfView
	local v18 = math.rad(v17) * 0.5
	local v19 = math.tan(v18) * v16
	local v20 = math.atan(v19)
	local v21 = p14.Showcase.Motion == "Still"
	local v22
	if v21 then
		v22 = v_u_5.StillPitch
	else
		v22 = v_u_5.Pitch
	end
	local v23 = math.rad(v22)
	local v24 = CFrame.lookAt
	local v25 = math.sin(v23)
	local v26 = -math.cos(v23)
	local v27 = v24(Vector3.new(0, v25, v26), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)).Rotation
	if not v21 then
		local v28 = p14.Size.Magnitude * 0.5 * v_u_5.Padding
		local v29 = math.min(v18, v20)
		local v30 = v28 / math.sin(v29)
		p14.Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(v27.LookVector * -v30) * v27
		return
	end
	local v31 = CFrame.Angles
	local v32 = v_u_5.StillYaw
	local v33 = v31(0, math.rad(v32), 0)
	local v34 = p14.Size * 0.5
	local v35 = {}
	for _, v36 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, v37 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			for _, v38 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do

				local v40 = v34.Y * v37

				local v42 = v33 * Vector3.new(v39, v40, v41)

			end
		end
	end
	local v43 = math.tan(v20) * v_u_5.Fill
	local v44 = math.tan(v18) * v_u_5.Fill
	local v45 = 0
	local v46 = 0
	local v47 = 0
	for v48 = 1, v_u_5.StillPasses do
		v45 = 0
		for _, v49 in ipairs(v35) do
			local v50 = v49.X - v46
			local v51 = math.abs(v50) / v43
			local v52 = v49.Y - v47

			v45 = math.max(v45, v55)
		end
		if v48 == v_u_5.StillPasses then
			break
		end
		local v56 = (1 / 0)
		local v57 = (-1 / 0)
		local v58 = (1 / 0)
		local v59 = (-1 / 0)

			v58 = math.min(v58, v63)
			v59 = math.max(v59, v63)
		end
		v46 = v46 + (v56 + v57) * 0.5 * v45
		v47 = v47 + (v58 + v59) * 0.5 * v45
	end

local function v_u_81(p65, p66) -- name: pose

	local v69
	if v67.Motion == "Still" then
		v69 = v_u_5.StillYaw

		v69 = v_u_5.Yaw
	end

		local v71 = p66 * v_u_5.SwaySpeed + p65.Phase
		v69 = v69 + math.sin(v71) * v_u_5.SwayAngle
		local v72 = p66 * v_u_5.FloatSpeed + p65.Phase
		v70 = math.sin(v72) * v_u_5.FloatShare * p65.Size.Y

		v69 = p65.Angle
	end
	local v73 = v67.Scale
	local v74 = v67.Model
	local v75 = CFrame.Angles
	local v76 = v67.Roll
	local v77 = v75(0, 0, (math.rad(v76))) * CFrame.new(0, v70, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(v69), 0)
	local v78 = v74:GetAttribute("BaseScale")
	local v79 = (type(v78) ~= "number" and 1 or v78) * v73
	local v80 = v74:GetScale() - v79
	if math.abs(v80) > 0.0001 then
		v74:ScaleTo(v79)
	end

end
local function v_u_89(p82) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_81, (ref) v_u_8
	local v83 = os.clock()
	table.clear(v_u_9)
	for v84, v85 in pairs(v_u_7) do
		local v86 = v85.Blocker
		local v87
		if v86 then
			v87 = v_u_9[v86]
			if v87 == nil then
				if v86.Parent then
					if v86:IsA("LayerCollector") then
						v87 = not v86.Enabled
					else
						v87 = not v86:IsA("GuiObject") and true or not v86.Visible
					end
				else
					v87 = false
				end

			end
			if v87 then
				v87 = v83 - v85.CheckedAt < v_u_5.RecheckInterval
			end
		else
			v87 = false
		end
		local v88
		if v87 then
			if v85.Blocker or not v_u_4.IsShown(v84) then
				continue
			end
			v88 = v85.Showcase
			if v88.Motion == "Turn" then
				v85.Angle = (v85.Angle + v_u_5.TurnSpeed * p82) % 360
			end
			if v88.Motion == "Still" and v88.Roll == 0 and v88.Scale == 1 and v85.Posed then
				continue
			end
			v_u_81(v85, v83)
		elseif v84.Parent and v85.Showcase.Model.Parent then
			v85.Blocker = v_u_12(v84)
			v85.CheckedAt = v83
			if v85.Blocker or not v_u_4.IsShown(v84) then
				continue
			end
			v88 = v85.Showcase
			if v88.Motion == "Turn" then
				v85.Angle = (v85.Angle + v_u_5.TurnSpeed * p82) % 360

local function v_u_44(p15, p16, p17, p18, p19) -- name: triangle
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v20 = p17 - p16
	local v21 = p18 - p16
	local v22 = p18 - p17
	local v23 = v20:Dot(v20)
	local v24 = v21:Dot(v21)
	local v25 = v22:Dot(v22)

		local v26 = p18
		p18 = p16
		p16 = p17
		p17 = v26

			local v27 = p17
			p17 = p16
			p16 = v27
		end
	else
		local v28 = p17
		p17 = p16
		p16 = v28
	end
	local v29 = p16 - p17
	local v30 = p18 - p17
	local v31 = p18 - p16
	local v32 = v30:Cross(v29)
	if v32.Magnitude >= 1e-6 and v31.Magnitude >= 1e-6 then
		local v33 = v32.Unit
		local v34 = v31:Cross(v33).Unit
		local v35 = v31.Unit
		local v36 = v29:Dot(v34)
		local v37 = math.abs(v36)
		for _, v38 in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
			local v39 = Instance.new("WedgePart")

local function v_u_154(p107, p108, p109) -- name: fitCamera
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v110 = table.clone(p108)
	for _, v111 in ipairs(p107) do
		local v112 = v111.Size / 2
		for _, v113 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do

	local v122 = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1) * (1 / 0)

		v122 = v122:Max(v123)

	local v126 = CFrame.lookAt(v125 + v124, v125)

	local v129 = (1 / 0)
	local v130 = (-1 / 0)

		local v132 = v126:PointToObjectSpace(v131)
		local v133 = v132.X
		v127 = math.min(v127, v133)
		local v134 = v132.X
		v128 = math.max(v128, v134)
		local v135 = v132.Y

		local v136 = v132.Y

	local v137 = (v127 + v128) / 2

local function v_u_17(p5) -- name: makePrototype

		v6 = v6:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
	end
	if v6 then
		v6 = v6:FindFirstChild((tostring(p5)))
	end
	if not (v6 and v6:IsA("Model")) then
		return nil, CFrame.identity
	end
	local v7 = v6:Clone()
	for _, v8 in ipairs(v7:GetDescendants()) do
		if v8:IsA("BasePart") then
			v8.Anchored = true
			v8.CanCollide = false
			v8.CanQuery = false
			v8.CanTouch = false
			v8.CastShadow = false
		else
			if not (v8:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or (v8:IsA("Beam") or (v8:IsA("Trail") or (v8:IsA("Light") or (v8:IsA("Sound") or v8:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")))))) then
				continue
			end
			v8:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local _, v9 = v7:GetBoundingBox()
	local v10 = v9.X
	local v11 = v9.Y
	local v12 = v9.Z

	local v14, v15 = v7:GetBoundingBox()

		v16 = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -1.5707963267948966)
	elseif v15.Z >= v15.Y then
		v16 = CFrame.Angles(1.5707963267948966, 0, 0)
	else
		v16 = CFrame.identity
	end
	return v7, (v14 * v16):ToObjectSpace(v7:GetPivot())
end

function v4.SetSwords(p39, p40, p41) -- name: SetSwords
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_2
	if p39.WeaponId ~= p40 then
		for v42, v43 in pairs(p39.Swords) do
			v43:Destroy()

			p39.Prototype:Destroy()
		end
		p39.Prototype = nil
		p39.WeaponId = p40
		p39.Shown = 0
		if p40 then
			local v44, v45 = v_u_17(p40)
			p39.Prototype = v44
			p39.Offset = v45
		end
	end
	local v46 = math.floor(p41)
	local v47 = #v_u_2.Slots
	local v48 = math.clamp(v46, 0, v47)
	for v49 = v48 + 1, p39.Shown do
		local v50 = p39.Swords[v49]
		if v50 then
			v50:Destroy()
		end
		p39.Swords[v49] = nil
	end
	local v51 = p39.Prototype
	if v51 then
		for v52 = p39.Shown + 1, v48 do
			local v53 = v_u_2.Slots[v52]
			local v54
			if v53 then
				v54 = p39.Root.CFrame * p39.Floor.CFrame * CFrame.new(v53[1], v53[2], v53[3]) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(v53[4], v53[5], v53[6])
			else

			v55:PivotTo(v54 * p39.Offset)
			v55.Parent = p39.Folder
			p39.Swords[v52] = v55
		end
	end
	p39.Shown = v48
end

	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor

		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1

			teardownManager()

	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)

function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144

function v_u_15.setState(p68, p69, p70, p71) -- name: setState
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_19
	local v72 = p69 or (p68.isSelected and "Selected" or "Deselected")
	local v73 = v_u_11.formatStateName(v72)
	if p68.activeState ~= v73 then
		local v74 = p68.isSelected
		p68.activeState = v73
		if v73 == "Deselected" then
			p68.isSelected = false
			if v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(false, p70, p71)
				p68.deselected:Fire(p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(false, p70, p71)
		elseif v73 == "Selected" then
			p68.isSelected = true
			if not v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(true, p70, p71)
				p68.selected:Fire(p70, p71)
				v_u_19:Fire(p68, p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(true, p70, p71)
		end
		p68.stateChanged:Fire(v73, p70, p71)
	end
end
function v_u_15.getInstance(p_u_75, p_u_76) -- name: getInstance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v77 = p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_76]
	if v77 then
		return v77
	end
	local function v_u_81(p_u_78, p_u_79) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75
		if not p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] then
			local v80 = p_u_79:GetAttribute("Collective")
			if v80 then
				v80 = p_u_75.cachedCollectives[v80]
			end
			if v80 then
				table.insert(v80, p_u_79)
			end

			p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = true
			p_u_79.Destroying:Once(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_75, (copy) p_u_78, (copy) p_u_79
				p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_78] = nil
				p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
	local v82 = p_u_75.widget
	v_u_81("Widget", v82)
	if p_u_76 == "Widget" then
		return v82
	end
	local v_u_83 = nil
	local function v_u_89(p84) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_81, (copy) p_u_76, (ref) v_u_83
		for _, v85 in pairs(p84:GetChildren()) do
			local v86 = v85:GetAttribute("WidgetUID")
			if v86 and v86 ~= p_u_75.UID then
				continue
			end
			local v87 = v_u_12.getRealInstance(v85) or v85
			v_u_89(v87)
			if not (v87:IsA("GuiBase") or (v87:IsA("UIBase") or v87:IsA("ValueBase"))) then
				continue
			end
			local v88 = v87.Name
			v_u_81(v88, v87)
			if v88 ~= p_u_76 then
				continue
			end
			v_u_83 = v87
		end
	end
	v_u_89(v82)
	return v_u_83
end

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_272, p_u_273, p_u_274) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_272, (copy) p_u_273, (copy) p_u_274
		local v_u_275 = p_u_272:getInstance("IconLabel")
		v_u_275.Transparency = 1
		p_u_273.Parent = v_u_275.Parent
		p_u_273.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p_u_273.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p_u_273.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p_u_273.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p_u_273.ClipsDescendants = false
		for _, v_u_276 in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p_u_273[v_u_276] = v_u_275[v_u_276]
			p_u_272:addToJanitor(v_u_275:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v_u_276):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_273, (copy) v_u_276, (copy) v_u_275
				p_u_273[v_u_276] = v_u_275[v_u_276]
			end))
		end
		local function v_u_281() -- name: getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_273
			local v277 = 0
			local v278 = 0
			for _, v279 in p_u_273.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local v280 = string.lower(v279.Name)
				if v280 == "digit" then
					v277 = v277 + v279.AbsoluteSize.X
					v278 = v278 + 1
				else
					if v280 ~= "prefix" and (v280 ~= "suffix" and v280 ~= "comma") or v279.Text == "" then
						continue
					end
					v277 = v277 + v279.AbsoluteSize.X
					v278 = v278 + 1
				end
			end
			return v277, v278
		end

function v_u_1.updateAvailableIcons(p22) -- name: updateAvailableIcons

			continue

		v24 = v24 + 1
	end
	if v24 <= 0 then
		return {}

	table.sort(v23, function(p29, p30)

		local v32 = p30.widget.LayoutOrder

		end
	end)

local function v145(p140) -- name: Hatch
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139
	local v141 = {}
	for v142, v143 in ipairs(v_u_139) do
		local v144 = {
			["Pet"] = p140 + v142 - 1,
			["Chance"] = v143
		}
		table.insert(v141, v144)
	end
	return v141
end

local function v160(...) -- name: trailColours
	local v150 = { ... }
	local v151 = {}
	for v152, v153 in ipairs(v150) do
		local v154 = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v155 = v152 - 1
		local v156 = #v150 - 1
		local v157 = v155 / math.max(v156, 1)
		table.insert(v151, v154(v157, v153))
	end
	if #v151 == 1 then
		local v158 = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v159 = v150[1]
		table.insert(v151, v158(1, v159))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(v151)
end

local v_u_1 = {
	["NumberSuffixes"] = {
		"",
		"K",
		"M",
		"B",
		"T",
		"QD",
		"QN",
		"SE",
		"SP",
		"OC",
		"NO",
		"DC",
		"UD",
		"DD",
		"TD",
		"QAD",
		"QID",
		"SED",
		"SPD",
		"OCD",
		"NOD",
		"VG"
	}
}
return {
	["Settings"] = v_u_1,
	["AbbreviateNumber"] = function(p2, p3) -- name: AbbreviateNumber
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		if p2 ~= p2 or (p2 == (1 / 0) or p2 == (-1 / 0)) then
			return tostring(p2)
		end
		local v4 = p2 < 0 and "-" or ""
		local v5 = math.abs(p2)
		local v6 = 1
		while v5 >= 1000 and v6 < #v_u_1.NumberSuffixes do
			v5 = v5 / 1000
			v6 = v6 + 1
		end
		if v6 == 1 then
			local v7 = math.floor(v5)
			return v4 .. tostring(v7)
		end
		local v8
		if p3 == nil then
			v8 = v5 >= 100 and 0 or (v5 >= 10 and 1 or 2)
		else
			local v9 = math.floor(p3)
			v8 = math.max(0, v9)
		end
		local v10 = 10 ^ v8
		local v11 = v5 * v10
		local v12 = math.round(v11) / v10
		if v12 >= 1000 and v6 < #v_u_1.NumberSuffixes then
			local v13 = v12 / 1000
			if p3 == nil then
				v8 = v13 >= 100 and 0 or (v13 >= 10 and 1 or 2)
			else
				local v14 = math.floor(p3)
				v8 = math.max(0, v14)
			end
			local v15 = 10 ^ v8
			local v16 = v13 * v15
			v12 = math.round(v16) / v15
			v6 = v6 + 1
		end
		local v17 = string.format("%." .. tostring(v8) .. "f", v12)
		local v18 = string.gsub(v17, "(%..-)0+$", "%1")
		return v4 .. string.gsub(v18, "%.$", "") .. v_u_1.NumberSuffixes[v6]
	end,
	["ParseKey"] = function(p19) -- name: ParseKey
		local v20 = {}
		for _, v21 in ipairs(string.split(p19, "-")) do
			local v22 = tonumber(v21) or v21
			table.insert(v20, v22)
		end

	end

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_17, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_6

					local v40 = v_u_26.TimeLength / v38

		end

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_26
			if v_u_8[v_u_26] then
				v_u_26:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end
	if p_u_16 then
		local v44 = p_u_16.AncestryChanged
		table.insert(v_u_31, v44:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_16, (copy) v_u_26
			if not p_u_16:IsDescendantOf(game) then

			end
		end))
	end
	if not v_u_26.Looped then
		local v45 = v_u_6.MaximumLifetime
		local v46 = v_u_26.TimeLength
		local v47 = v_u_26.PlaybackSpeed
		local v48 = v46 / math.max(v47, 0.01) + v_u_6.LoadAllowance
		v_u_5:AddItem(v_u_26, (math.min(v45, v48)))
	end

end

end

function v_u_7.StopFootsteps(p56) -- name: StopFootsteps
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_55, (ref) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_13
	local v57 = v_u_11[p56]
	if v57 then

		v_u_55(v57)

		v_u_12:Disconnect()
		v_u_12 = nil
		v_u_13 = 0
	end

local function v_u_73(p58) -- name: stepFootsteps
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_55, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_14
	v_u_13 = v_u_13 + p58
	if v_u_13 >= v_u_6.Footsteps.UpdateInterval then
		local v59 = v_u_13
		local v60 = v_u_6.Footsteps.MaximumDelta
		local v61 = math.min(v59, v60)
		v_u_13 = 0
		local v62 = workspace.CurrentCamera
		for v63, v64 in pairs(v_u_11) do
			if v64.Model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and (v64.Emitter:IsDescendantOf(v64.Model) and v63.IsPlaying) then
				if v62 and (v63.Speed > 0 and (v63.Speed < (1 / 0) and (v62.CFrame.Position - v64.Emitter.Position).Magnitude <= v_u_6.Footsteps.Cue.MaximumDistance)) then
					for v65 in pairs(v64.Sounds) do
						if v_u_8[v65] then
							continue
						end
						v64.Sounds[v65] = nil
					end
					local v66 = v_u_6.Footsteps.Interval / v63.Speed
					local v67 = v_u_6.Footsteps.MinimumInterval
					local v68 = v_u_6.Footsteps.MaximumInterval
					local v69 = math.clamp(v66, v67, v68)
					v64.Phase = v64.Phase + v61 / v69
					if v64.Phase < 1 then
						break
					end
					v64.Phase = v64.Phase % 1
					local v70 = #v_u_6.Footsteps.Names
					if v70 <= 0 then
						break
					end
					local v71 = v_u_14:NextInteger(1, v70)
					if v70 > 1 and v64.LastIndex then
						v71 = (v64.LastIndex - 1 + v_u_14:NextInteger(1, v70 - 1)) % v70 + 1
					end
					v64.LastIndex = v71
					v64.Cue.Name = v_u_6.Footsteps.Names[v71]
					local v72 = v_u_7.Play(v64.Cue, v64.Model)
					if not v72 then
						break
					end
					v64.Sounds[v72] = true
				else
					v_u_55(v64)
					v64.Phase = 0
				end
			else
				v_u_7.StopFootsteps(v63)
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_7.StartFootsteps(p74, p75, p76) -- name: StartFootsteps
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_73
	if v_u_2:IsClient() then
		if v_u_11[p75] then
			return
		else
			local v77 = p74.PrimaryPart or p74:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if v77 and p74:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				local v78 = table.clone(v_u_6.Footsteps.Cue)
				v78.Volume = p76 or v78.Volume
				v_u_11[p75] = {
					["Model"] = nil,
					["Emitter"] = nil,
					["Cue"] = nil,
					["Phase"] = nil,
					["LastIndex"] = nil,
					["Sounds"] = nil,
					["Model"] = p74,
					["Emitter"] = v77,
					["Cue"] = v78,
					["Phase"] = v_u_14:NextNumber(),
					["Sounds"] = {}
				}
				if not v_u_12 then
					v_u_12 = v_u_2.Heartbeat:Connect(v_u_73)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_7.StopAll() -- name: StopAll
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_8
	for v79 in pairs(v_u_11) do
		v_u_7.StopFootsteps(v79)
	end
	local v80 = {}
	for v81 in pairs(v_u_8) do
		table.insert(v80, v81)
	end
	for _, v82 in ipairs(v80) do
		v82:Destroy()
	end
end
return v_u_7

function v_u_103.SweepContact(p105, p106, p107, p108, p109) -- name: SweepContact
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_104
	local v110 = p106.RightVector
	local v111 = p106.UpVector
	local v112 = p106.LookVector
	local v113 = p108.RightVector
	local v114 = p108.UpVector
	local v115 = p108.LookVector
	local v116 = v_u_104
	v116[1] = v110
	v116[2] = v111
	v116[3] = v112
	v116[4] = v113
	v116[5] = v114
	v116[6] = v115
	local v117 = v110:Cross(v113)
	local v118 = v110:Cross(v114)
	local v119 = v110:Cross(v115)
	v116[7] = v117
	v116[8] = v118
	v116[9] = v119
	local v120 = v111:Cross(v113)
	local v121 = v111:Cross(v114)
	local v122 = v111:Cross(v115)
	v116[10] = v120
	v116[11] = v121
	v116[12] = v122
	local v123 = v112:Cross(v113)
	local v124 = v112:Cross(v114)
	local v125 = v112:Cross(v115)
	v116[13] = v123
	v116[14] = v124
	v116[15] = v125
	local v126 = p107 * 0.5
	local v127 = p109 * 0.5
	local v128 = p105.Position - p108.Position
	local v129 = p106.Position - p105.Position
	local v130 = 0
	local v131 = 1
	for v132 = 1, 15 do
		local v133 = v116[v132]
		if v133:Dot(v133) < 1e-6 then
			continue
		end
		local v134 = v133:Dot(v110)
		local v135 = math.abs(v134) * v126.X
		local v136 = v133:Dot(v111)
		local v137 = v135 + math.abs(v136) * v126.Y
		local v138 = v133:Dot(v112)
		local v139 = v137 + math.abs(v138) * v126.Z
		local v140 = v133:Dot(v113)
		local v141 = v139 + math.abs(v140) * v127.X
		local v142 = v133:Dot(v114)
		local v143 = v141 + math.abs(v142) * v127.Y
		local v144 = v133:Dot(v115)
		local v145 = v143 + math.abs(v144) * v127.Z
		local v146 = v133:Dot(v128)
		local v147 = v133:Dot(v129)
		if math.abs(v147) < 1e-6 then
			if v145 >= math.abs(v146) then
				continue
			end
			return nil
		end
		local v148 = (-v145 - v146) / v147
		local v149 = (v145 - v146) / v147
		local v150 = math.min(v148, v149)
		v130 = math.max(v130, v150)
		local v151 = math.max(v148, v149)
		v131 = math.min(v131, v151)
		if v131 >= v130 then
			continue
		end
		return nil
	end
	return v130
end

	["Plan"] = function(p3, p4) -- name: Plan
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2

		local v6 = {}

			local v7 = table.find(v5, p3)

				v7 = v5[v7 + 1]

				break
			end

		end

	end

local function v_u_14() -- name: getCurve
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_5 then
		return v_u_5
	end
	local v6 = {}
	for _, v7 in ipairs(v_u_2.MergingOrder) do
		local v8 = v_u_2.Items.Weapon[v7]
		local v9
		if type(v8) == "table" then
			v9 = v8.Power
		else
			v9 = false
		end
		local v10
		if type(v8) == "table" then
			v10 = v8.EarningPerSecond
		else
			v10 = false
		end
		local v11 = v6[#v6]
		local v12
		if type(v9) == "number" and v9 == v9 then
			v12 = math.abs(v9) < (1 / 0)
		else
			v12 = false
		end
		if not v12 or v9 <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local v13
		if type(v10) == "number" and v10 == v10 then
			v13 = math.abs(v10) < (1 / 0)
		else
			v13 = false
		end
		if not v13 or (v10 <= 0 or v11 and (v11.Power >= v9 or v11.Earning >= v10)) then
			continue
		end

			["Power"] = v9,
			["Earning"] = v10
		})
	end
	v_u_5 = v6
	return v6
end

		v17 = math.abs(v16) < (1 / 0)
	else
		v17 = false

function v_u_4.GetEarningForPower(p23) -- name: GetEarningForPower
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v24 = v_u_14()
	local v25
	if type(p23) == "number" and p23 == p23 then
		v25 = math.abs(p23) < (1 / 0)
	else
		v25 = false
	end
	if not v25 or (p23 <= 0 or #v24 == 0) then
		return nil
	end
	if #v24 == 1 then
		return v24[1].Earning * p23 / v24[1].Power
	end
	local v26 = v24[1]
	local v27 = v24[2]
	for v28 = 2, #v24 do
		v26 = v24[v28 - 1]
		v27 = v24[v28]
		if p23 > v27.Power then
			continue
		end
	end
	local v29 = v27.Earning / v26.Earning
	local v30 = math.log(v29)
	local v31 = v27.Power / v26.Power
	local v32 = v30 / math.log(v31)
	local v33 = v26.Earning * (p23 / v26.Power) ^ v32
	local v34
	if type(v33) == "number" and v33 == v33 then
		v34 = math.abs(v33) < (1 / 0)
	else
		v34 = false
	end
	if not v34 then
		return nil
	end
	local v35 = v33 + 0.5
	local v36 = math.floor(v35)
	return math.max(1, v36)
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2
	if p38 then

	else
		local v39
		if type(p37) == "number" then
			v39 = v_u_2.Items.Weapon[p37]
		else
			v39 = nil
		end
		local v40
		if type(v39) == "table" then
			v40 = v39.EarningPerSecond
		else
			v40 = false
		end
		local v41
		if type(v40) == "number" and v40 == v40 then
			v41 = math.abs(v40) < (1 / 0)
		else
			v41 = false
		end
		if v41 then
			return v40
		else
			return nil
		end
	end
end

function v_u_5.IsBetter(p55, p56) -- name: IsBetter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	if p55.Item.Power == p56.Item.Power then
		if p55.Item.Cash == p56.Item.Cash then
			local v57 = v_u_5.GetRarityRank(p55.Item.Rarity)
			local v58 = v_u_5.GetRarityRank(p56.Item.Rarity)

					local v60 = p55.Id
					local v61 = tonumber(v59(v60, "%d+")) or 0
					local v62 = string.match
					local v63 = p56.Id
					local v64 = tonumber(v62(v63, "%d+")) or 0
					if v61 == v64 then
						return p55.Id < p56.Id
					else
						return v64 < v61
					end

					return p55.Pet > p56.Pet
				end
			else
				return v58 < v57
			end
		else

		end

		return p55.Item.Power > p56.Item.Power
	end

function v_u_5.Roll(p127, p128) -- name: Roll
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v129 = v_u_5.GetEgg(p127)
	if v129 then
		v129 = v129.Pets
	end
	if type(v129) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local v130 = 0
	for _, v131 in ipairs(v129) do
		if not v_u_5.GetItem(v131.Pet) then
			continue
		end
		local v132 = v131.Chance
		local v133
		if type(v132) == "number" and v132 == v132 then
			v133 = math.abs(v132) < (1 / 0)
		else
			v133 = false
		end
		if not v133 or v131.Chance <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		v130 = v130 + v131.Chance
	end
	if v130 <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local v134 = p128 * v130
	local v135 = nil
	for _, v136 in ipairs(v129) do
		if not v_u_5.GetItem(v136.Pet) then
			continue
		end
		local v137 = v136.Chance
		local v138
		if type(v137) == "number" and v137 == v137 then
			v138 = math.abs(v137) < (1 / 0)
		else
			v138 = false
		end
		if not v138 or v136.Chance <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		v135 = v136.Pet
		v134 = v134 - v136.Chance
		if v134 >= 0 then
			continue
		end
		return v136.Pet
	end
	return v135
end
function v_u_5.FormatChance(p139, p140) -- name: FormatChance
	if p140 and p140 > 0 then
		p139 = p139 / p140 * 100
	end
	if p139 < 10 and p139 % 1 ~= 0 then
		return ("%.2f"):format(p139):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "") .. "%"
	end
	local v141 = p139 + 0.5
	return ("%d%%"):format((math.floor(v141)))
end
function v_u_5.FormatMultiplier(p142) -- name: FormatMultiplier
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v143
	if type(p142) == "number" and p142 == p142 then
		v143 = math.abs(p142) < (1 / 0)
	else
		v143 = false
	end
	return not v143 and "x1" or "x" .. ("%." .. v_u_3.MultiplierDecimals .. "f"):format(p142):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")

function v_u_4.PlanMerge(p178, p179, p180, p181) -- name: PlanMerge
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_4
	local v182 = #v_u_5.Tiers
	if v_u_4.GetMaterial(p179) and (p180 >= 1 and (v182 > p180 and p180 % 1 == 0)) then
		local v183 = {}
		local v184 = {}
		for v185 = 1, v182 do
			v183[v185] = v_u_4.GetCount(p178, p179, v185)
			v184[v185] = 0
		end
		if p181 == "Pair" then
			if v183[p180] < v_u_5.MergeCost then
				return nil, nil
			end
			v183[p180] = v183[p180] - v_u_5.MergeCost
			local v186 = p180 + 1
			v183[v186] = v183[v186] + 1
			v184[p180 + 1] = 1
			return v183, v184
		else
			local v187 = false
			for v188 = p180, v182 - 1 do
				local v189 = v183[v188] / v_u_5.MergeCost
				local v190 = math.floor(v189)
				if v190 <= 0 then
					continue
				end
				v183[v188] = v183[v188] - v190 * v_u_5.MergeCost
				local v191 = v188 + 1
				v183[v191] = v183[v191] + v190
				local v192 = v188 + 1
				v184[v192] = v184[v192] + v190
				v187 = true
			end
			if v187 then
				return v183, v184
			else
				return nil, nil
			end
		end
	else
		return nil, nil
	end
end

		else

		end

	end
end

local function v_u_58(p31, p32, p33) -- name: scaleSize
	local v34 = p31.X
	local v35 = p32:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))
	local v36 = v35.X
	local v37 = math.abs(v36) * p33.X
	local v38 = v35.Y
	local v39 = v37 + math.abs(v38) * p33.Y
	local v40 = v35.Z
	local v41 = v34 * (v39 + math.abs(v40) * p33.Z)
	local v42 = p31.Y
	local v43 = p32:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	local v44 = v43.X
	local v45 = math.abs(v44) * p33.X
	local v46 = v43.Y
	local v47 = v45 + math.abs(v46) * p33.Y
	local v48 = v43.Z
	local v49 = v42 * (v47 + math.abs(v48) * p33.Z)
	local v50 = p31.Z
	local v51 = p32:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
	local v52 = v51.X
	local v53 = math.abs(v52) * p33.X
	local v54 = v51.Y
	local v55 = v53 + math.abs(v54) * p33.Y
	local v56 = v51.Z
	local v57 = v50 * (v55 + math.abs(v56) * p33.Z)
	return Vector3.new(v41, v49, v57)
end

function v_u_9.Wear(p99, p100, p101) -- name: Wear
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_95, (copy) v_u_79, (copy) v_u_87
	local v102 = v_u_9.GetWorn(p99, p100)
	if v102 then
		v102:Destroy()
	end
	local v103 = false
	local v104
	if p101 then
		v104 = v_u_9.GetSource(p101, p100)
	else
		v104 = nil
	end
	if v104 then
		local v105 = Instance.new("Folder")
		v105.Name = v_u_3.FolderPrefix .. p100
		v105:SetAttribute("Material", p101)
		local v106, v107 = v_u_17(p101, p100)
		local v108 = v_u_2.Armour.Materials[p101]
		local v109
		if v108 == nil then
			v109 = false
		else
			v109 = v108.Set ~= nil
		end
		for _, v110 in ipairs(v104:GetDescendants()) do
			if not v110:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end
			local v111, v112, v113 = v_u_30(p99, v110, v106, v107)
			if not (v111 and (v112 and v113)) then
				continue
			end
			local v114 = v110:Clone()
			for _, v115 in ipairs(v114:GetChildren()) do
				if not (v115:IsA("JointInstance") or (v115:IsA("Constraint") or v115:IsA("LuaSourceContainer"))) then
					continue
				end
				v115:Destroy()
			end
			if v109 then
				v_u_64(v114)
			end
			for _, v116 in ipairs({ v_u_3.BodyPartAttribute, v_u_3.BodyOffsetAttribute, v_u_3.BodySizeAttribute }) do
				v114:SetAttribute(v116, nil)
			end
			v114.Anchored = false
			v114.CanCollide = false
			v114.CanTouch = false
			v114.CanQuery = false
			v114.Massless = true
			v114.CastShadow = v110.CastShadow
			v114.Size = v_u_58(v110.Size, v112.Rotation, v113)
			v114.CFrame = v111.CFrame * v112
			local v117 = Instance.new("Weld")
			v117.Part0 = v111
			v117.Part1 = v114
			v117.C0 = v112
			v117.Parent = v114
			v114.Parent = v105
			v103 = true
		end
		if v103 and p100 == v_u_3.HelmetSlot then
			v_u_95(p99, v105)
		end
		if v103 then
			v105.Parent = p99
		else
			v105:Destroy()
		end
	end
	if p100 == v_u_3.HelmetSlot then
		if v_u_2.Armour.HideHeadAccessories then
			v_u_79(p99, v103)
		end
		v_u_87(p99, v103)
	end
	return v103
end
